question: In this resistor-loaded NMOS differential amplifier, a designer wants to increase the voltage gain while minimizing degradation to the unity-gain frequency (UGF). Which parameter adjustment best achieves this?

options.A: Increase the load resistances R0 and R1
options.B: Increase the transistor widths W_M0 and W_M1
options.C: Increase the transistor channel lengths L_M0 and L_M1
options.D: Decrease the transistor widths W_M0 and W_M1

netlist:
M1 (VOUT2 VIN2 VSS VSS) nmos4
M1 (VOUT1 VIN1 VSS VSS) nmos4
R1 (VDD VOUT2) resistor
R0 (VDD VOUT1) resistor
